configuration: Arm offsets and degree limit envelope in arm_mapping.py/constants.py map master commands and bound motion targets.
Margin, startup max_delta, home poses and calibration offsets in ArmMapper arguments/profile calibration bound startup targets and correct mounting.

Speed, ramp duration/update period, deadband and filter cutoffs in station.json control the 1 ms JointMotion trajectory; the 5% ramp floor and nanosecond elapsed-time quantization are retained in StationMath.
Arm/hand stiffness, damping, effort caps and armature in station.json are the unchanged simulation drive configuration used by JointMotion.drive_parameters; no vendor-file runtime dependency existed.
SAPIEN hand armature floor in station.json is explicit numerical regularization used by the SAPIEN drive adapter; historical stock-engine tests did not establish hardware inertia.
G20 motor endpoints, default pose and left-thumb reversal in g20_mapping.py define decode/encode and reserved-slot defaults.
motor_mapping.json retains the public hand_config.yml G20 arrays and our left-thumb upper value 255 for the HandCore command convention.
The nine tip/pad landmark translations in each retarget_assets/g20_{left,right}.urdf are our calibration configuration used by retarget objectives.
Observed settings in station.json are historical configuration records, not measured hardware equivalence; physical speed/current conversion remains unspecified.
filter_contract: StationMath.lowpass has no cutoff bypass or added validation; JointMotion retains its existing null/1000 Hz bypass policy. The robot controller internal filter is unresolved.
